newsitem.title: USA: Digitran reaches class action settlement.
newsitem.headline: Digitran reaches class action settlement.

text.p: Digitran Systems Inc said Wednesday it reached a preliminary settlement in the class action law suit filed against the company in August 1993.
All parties have agreed to the detailed terms and final signature is expected "shortly," the company said. But the terms were not disclosed.
The allegations in the suit concerned improper recognition of income.
In September, Digitran filed for Chapter 11 protection in order, it said, to protect shareholders, creditors and employees from a "perceived rush to judgment" in the suit.
For the quarter ending January 31, 1997, the company reported net sales of $1,497,018 and net income of $15,379.
Digitran Systems is a manufacturer and world-wide marketer of training simulators for the petroleum industry, as well as a line of crane simulators for the maritime and construction industries.
